style: Warm, softly lit cartoon wood and cream rope, retaining original palette family and modular construction.
inspectionMethods: Direct inspection of original and fixed target RGBA pixels.
Direct inspection of all four source native facings, enlarged and at logical 192 x 352 size over light, middle gray, and dark backgrounds.
Read authored half-post/rope construction and source camera, rig, catalog and port records.
Read-only background Blender inspection of the declared source .blend collection, its mesh members, root, transforms, and orthographic camera; no scene save or edit.
sourceObservations: N and S show two deliberately partial golden wood posts, two cream bindings per post, broad light caps, and a sagging cream span. At use size the bright rope is readable, but each span segment reads as a flat bright block and the cap reads as a nearly uniform yellow plate.

E and W are true end-on views: the near half-post presents a broad planar join face and overlaps the span in depth. Those authored faces are intentional modular boundaries, not image clipping or missing full-post geometry.

The body already has some vertical wood value change, but the lower near end-on face is a broad unmodulated gradient and the side-to-cap transition is a sharp graphic stripe. Softer local volume would make the material more consistent with the requested warm cartoon treatment.
Baseline light-gray/dark-background views show no large background cast shadow; the partial silhouettes and full frame padding are established by native registration, not by the target canvas.
targetObservations: The target suggests warm amber body volume, gently highlighted cap edges, creamy rope with readable top/front/underside form, and restrained wood variation.

The target also exaggerates pillowy rope blocks, gloss, outline glow, grain, and its canvas/occupied size. These are not authorities for topology, silhouette, scale, port profile, registration, or required detail.
The target is one broadside view only; it supplies no unseen end-on reference. Required E/W facings must be judged for native coherent construction, controlled lighting, and material readability.

nativeContract.construction: Source script creates half-posts inside x=-0.5 and x=+0.5 planes, .153 radius body, .164 bindings, .175 cap; saws rope ends flush at the same planes. Adjacent cells reconstruct full posts. Preserve the cross-section/handedness and plane contact.
nativeContract.lighting: No preferred horizontal direction; no directional ground cast shadow.
nativeContract.evidenceLimits: Reference inspection establishes intent and baseline. No candidate or native joined preview was supplied yet; profile continuity and all candidate technical assertions remain to be checked against an immutable candidate packet.

rankedDesiredOutcomes.outcome: Read soft wood and rope volume at logical size while retaining the actual half-post boundaries, sag, cap/binding construction and native join profile.

Use warm amber wood and cream rope with broad controlled highlights and mild material variation; eliminate the near-uniform yellow cap and flat white-block impression without adding gloss or texture noise.
Keep all four native facings and repeated joins clean: continuous posts/bindings at ports, rope contact, no cracks, dark wedges, broken normals, halos or directional shadow.
